headline: Oil Rises 2.08 Percent To $104.12 As Copper Falls 1.86 Percent To $6.46
narrative: Oil rose 2.08 percent to $104.12, money moving into the energy pipe. Copper fell 1.86 percent to $6.46, the industrial-metal pipe giving up ground, and the S&P 500 fell 1.82 percent to 7,580.07. Bitcoin traded near 77k as crude took the bid the metal and equity pipes gave up.
author: jordan
